description: This file implements a generic LoggerAdapter class that wraps the Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger interface, providing methods for logging warnings and informational messages within the infrastructure of the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: LoggerAdapter<T>
classes.description: A generic logging adapter class that implements IAppLogger<T> and delegates logging calls to an internal ILogger<T> instance.

methods.name: LoggerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the internal ILogger<T> via an ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional arguments.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional arguments.
